title: Canada’s Pembina Advances Gas-Fired Data Center Project
key_facts: Kalkine Media says Pembina and partners reached a final investment decision on the Greenlight Electricity Centre, a gas-fired power project designed around a data centre owned by a major technology company.
The Energy Mix says Meta's data centre in Sturgeon County is linked to Greenlight, which is approved for construction at the same site, with power due in late 2030.
quote_evidence: The Calgary-based energy infrastructure company reached a final investment decision with its partners on the Greenlight Electricity Centre, a natural gas-fired power project designed around a data centre owned by a major technology company.
event_date: Final investment decision date not stated; EnergyNow page is a July 2026 article
notes: EnergyNow page (July 2026) returned no text; Kalkine gives only thin, promotional-style coverage. Treated as headline-level and older news re-dated.
